test_scheduler_compute_optimal_schedule: test the Scheduler class ComputeOptimalSchedule method with a simple graph and memory limit of 1024
test_scheduler_with_fragmentation: test the Scheduler ComputeOptimalSchedule with account_for_fragmentation and defrag enabled on a simple graph
test_scheduler_diamond_graph: test the Scheduler ComputeOptimalSchedule on a diamond-shaped graph with fragmentation and defrag enabled
test_scheduler_control_dep_graph: test the Scheduler ComputeOptimalSchedule on a control dependency graph with fragmentation handling enabled
test_scheduler_with_spills: test the Scheduler ComputeOptimalSchedule on a control dep graph allowing up to 180 bytes of data spills
